key.name: bar-style
key.summary: Bar style: the id of a style registered in lib/styles.js

key.name: taskbar-clock
key.summary: Show the clock and date at the end of the taskbar

key.name: taskbar-merge-panel
key.summary: Merge the GNOME top bar into the taskbar
key.description: In the taskbar styles the clock, tray, indicators and Activities move into the taskbar and the top bar disappears (bottom or top taskbar only).

key.name: hug-edge-when-maximized
key.summary: Touch the screen edge while a window is maximized
key.description: The floating Dock drops its margin and touches the edge while a maximized window is on its monitor, and floats again when there is none.

key.name: panel-to-bottom
key.summary: Move the top bar to the bottom when the Dock is on top
key.description: While the Dock is at the top of the screen, GNOME's top bar moves to the bottom edge, so the two do not compete for the same space.

key.name: magnification-radius
key.summary: How far the magnification wave reaches, in icons

key.name: magnification-rise
key.summary: Extra lift of the magnified icon, in pixels

key.name: magnification-make-room
key.summary: Neighbours slide apart for the magnified icon

key.name: magnification-magnetic-strength
key.summary: Magnetic: how strongly icons snap to the pointer, in pixels

key.name: magnification-smoothness
key.summary: How quickly icons follow the pointer (higher is snappier)

key.name: minimize-duration
key.summary: Duration of the minimize and restore animation, in milliseconds

key.name: minimize-to-app
key.summary: Minimize windows into the application icon
key.description: When false, minimized windows get their own item near the trash, like on macOS.

key.name: autohide
key.summary: Automatically hide and show the dock

key.name: animate-launch
key.summary: Bounce the icon while an application is opening

key.name: bounce-on-attention
key.summary: Bounce the icon when an application requests attention

key.name: show-recent
key.summary: Show suggested and recent applications in the dock

key.name: apps-button-separator
key.summary: Separator between the applications button and the apps

key.name: apps-button-logo
key.summary: Logo shown on the applications button
key.description: Used when the button icon is set to "Logo". "system" follows LOGO= in /etc/os-release.

key.name: apps-button-custom-icon
key.summary: Path of a custom image for the applications button

key.name: apps-button-icon-scale
key.summary: Size of the applications button icon, in percent

key.name: window-previews
key.summary: Show live window previews when hovering an application icon

key.name: show-badges
key.summary: Show notification badges and progress bars on icons

key.name: dynamic-calendar-icon
key.description: Kept only to migrate old settings: when false, calendar-icon-style starts as "theme".

key.name: calendar-icon-style
key.summary: Calendar icon look: follow the icon theme, or the Dock's own icon with today's date

key.name: trash-icon-style
key.summary: Trash icon look: follow the icon theme, or the Dock's own trash

key.name: ignored-window-classes
key.summary: Hidden windows: window classes the dock ignores
key.description: Windows whose class (Wayland app_id) matches one of these patterns never show up on the dock. Separate patterns with commas; "*" matches any text.

key.name: hide-overview-dash
key.summary: Hide the native dash in the Activities overview

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Background color for the custom theme

key.name: use-gradient
key.summary: Blend the custom background into a second color

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the dock background tint

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Width of the outline around the dock

key.name: dock-padding
key.summary: Extra space between the icons and the dock edge

key.name: indicator-color-mode
key.summary: Where the indicator color comes from

key.name: badge-color-mode
key.summary: Where the notification badge color comes from

key.name: popup-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of labels, previews and stacks

key.name: separator-thickness
key.summary: Thickness of the separators (0 hides them)

key.name: separator-length
key.summary: Length of the separators, as a share of the icon size

key.name: dock-margin
key.summary: Distance between the dock and the screen edge

key.name: icon-reflection
key.summary: Show a reflection under the icons

key.name: blur-mode
key.summary: Dynamic follows what is behind the dock; static uses an image

key.name: blur-static-source
key.summary: Image used by the static blur

key.name: blur-static-preset
key.summary: Preset image for the static blur

key.name: blur-custom-photo
key.summary: Path of your own photo for the static blur

key.name: blur-vibrancy
key.summary: Colour saturation seen through the glass

key.name: blur-brightness
key.summary: Tone of the glass, from dark (0) to light (1)
key.description: The brightness band the adaptive glass pulls the background towards.

key.name: blur-tint-opacity
key.summary: How much of the tint shows

key.name: blur-border-glow
key.summary: Strength of the light and shadow along the rim

key.name: blur-highlight-angle
key.summary: Where the light on the rim falls from, in degrees

key.name: blur-adaptive
key.summary: How much the glass evens out bright and dark backgrounds

key.name: blur-refraction
key.summary: How much the thick edge of the glass bends the background

key.name: blur-dispersion
key.summary: Faint rainbow split of colours along the edge

key.name: blur-sheen
key.summary: Soft reflection of light coming from the top

key.name: blur-grain
key.summary: Barely visible grain that keeps dark gradients smooth

key.name: show-mounts
key.summary: Show USB and other drives while they are connected

key.name: downloads-icon-style
key.description: "files": the newest files stacked on the icon; "arrow": a folder with a download arrow.

key.name: stack-view
key.summary: How stacks open: automatic, grid, fan or list

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: Show the dock on all monitors
key.description: If false, the dock is shown only on the primary monitor.

key.name: wobbly-enabled
key.description: Windows bend and wobble like jelly while they are moved.

key.name: wobbly-preset
key.description: Only used by the preferences window to fill the spring, friction and mass values.

key.name: wobbly-spring
key.description: Higher values make the window snap back faster and bend less.

key.name: wobbly-friction
key.description: Higher values stop the wobbling sooner.

key.name: wobbly-mass
key.description: Heavier windows swing slower and wider.

key.name: wobbly-mesh
key.description: Number of spring points on each side of the window.

key.name: wobbly-maximize
key.summary: Wobble when maximizing, restoring and moving with the keyboard

key.name: start-menu
key.description: On the taskbar, the start button opens the Orla Dock Start Menu instead of GNOME's app grid.

key.name: start-menu-replace-grid
key.summary: Start menu instead of the app grid
key.description: Double Super, the dash app grid button and Super+A open the Orla Dock Start Menu instead of GNOME's app grid. A single Super still opens the Overview.

key.name: start-menu-style
key.description: Layout of the start menu: classic (two columns), modern, categories, alphabetical or launchpad (centered grid).

key.name: start-menu-position
key.description: Where the start menu opens: next to the dock, in a corner of the screen, or centered.

key.name: start-menu-size
key.description: Overall size of the start menu.

key.name: start-menu-animate
key.description: Short fade and slide when the start menu opens and closes.

key.name: start-menu-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the start menu background. The minimum keeps text readable over any wallpaper.

key.name: start-menu-glass
key.description: Show a frosted copy of the wallpaper behind the start menu. Computed once, light on the graphics card.

key.name: start-menu-shortcut
key.description: Extra keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the start menu. Empty means none.

key.name: start-menu-recent-apps
key.description: Show the Recent apps row on the start menu's home page.

key.name: start-menu-continue
key.description: Show Continue where you left off on the start menu's home page.

key.name: start-menu-search-providers
key.description: Include results from GNOME search providers, like Characters and Calendar, in start menu search.

key.name: start-menu-web-search
key.description: Offer a web search for the typed text at the end of start menu search results.

key.name: start-menu-web-search-url
key.description: Address used for web search. %s is replaced with the search text.

key.name: start-menu-recent-files
key.description: How many recent files the start menu shows under Continue where you left off.

key.name: start-menu-recent-app-ids
key.description: App IDs ordered from the most recently opened or closed, used for the start menu's Recent apps row.

key.name: start-menu-all-apps-grid
key.summary: Start menu all apps as a grid
key.description: Show the start menu's All apps page as a grid of icons instead of a list.

key.name: tray-order
key.description: Order of the icons inside the tray popup.

key.name: tray-panel-indicators
key.summary: Tray icons shown on the panel
key.description: Small status icons the user chose to keep on the panel instead of inside the tray.

key.name: tray-wide-indicators
key.summary: Wide applets shown in the tray
key.description: Wide applets, such as ones with text or graphs, the user chose to show as a row inside the tray instead of on the panel.

key.name: panel-applet-order
key.summary: Order of extension applets on the panel, changed with Ctrl + drag

key.name: panel-workspace-indicator
key.description: Show the workspace pills at the start of the panel in Panel Mode.

key.name: panel-date-format
key.description: GLib date format used for the date line under the panel clock.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-enabled
key.description: Show the wavebar-music-pill widget (the song that is playing) on the dock, between the applications button and the pinned apps.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-mode
key.description: Compact: the size of an icon (cover and animated bars). Expanded: a wider pill with cover, title and artist.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-separators
key.description: Show a separator on each side of the music widget.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-controls
key.description: Show previous, play/pause and next buttons in the widget.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-lyrics
key.description: Show the current line of synced lyrics in the expanded widget. Sends the song title and artist to LRCLIB to find the lyrics.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-expand-on-hover
key.description: In compact mode, expand the widget while the pointer is over it.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-expand-on-track-change
key.description: In compact mode, expand the widget for a few seconds when the song changes.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-track-change-duration
key.description: How many seconds the widget stays expanded after the song changes.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-max-width
key.description: Maximum width of the expanded widget, in pixels.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-show-cover
key.description: Show the album cover in the widget.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-scroll-title
key.description: Scroll titles that do not fit, back and forth.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-show-without-player
key.description: Keep a discreet music item on the dock even when no player is open.

key.name: wavebar-music-pill-lyrics-cache-stamp
key.description: Internal: changed by the preferences to clear the lyrics cache.
